versions.changelog:
Initial release: Pro Pack for AI avatar & talking head video with RunComfy CLI.

- Supports multiple audio-driven avatar models: OmniHuman, Wan 2-7, HappyHorse 1.0, Seedance v2 Pro, and Wan 2-2 Animate.
- Automatically routes user prompts to the best model for the intended avatar video use case.
- Handles diverse scenarios: lip-sync on photos, script-to-video, cinematic references, full-body animation, and more.
- Provides exact RunComfy CLI invocations and documented prompting patterns for each model.
- Triggers on a wide range of talking head, avatar video, and lip-sync related user requests.
